title: LLM video-agent methods: task → workflow taxonomy
classification_unit: The reported inference/construction configuration, not a permanent capability label for a model; nested and training workflows are qualified in notes.

workflow_definitions.W1: The configured model directly proposes an artifact; a separate model-directed inspection/repair loop is not part of that setting.
workflow_definitions.W2: A prescribed observation/planning/execution sequence; fixed best-of-k selection alone remains W2.
workflow_definitions.W3: Execution, inspection, critique or human feedback changes a later draft, tool action or adaptive search decision. Feedback that only updates skills or memory for later tasks is an adaptation attribute, not W3.
workflow_definitions.W4: Fresh external observations or user/environment actions drive continuing decisions over persistent state or model hypotheses; an engine-only runtime loop is insufficient.
workflow_definitions.component: Verifier, renderer, asset interface or comparative diagnostic without a separate temporal-agent workflow.
